import React, { useState } from "react"; import { Button, Card, CardHeader, CardBody, FormGroup, Form, Input, Container, Row, Col, Collapse, Alert, } from "reactstrap"; import UserHeader from "components/Headers/UserHeader.js"; import { getDatabase, ref, set } from "firebase/database"; // Firebase imports import { getAuth } from "firebase/auth"; // For user authentication const CarbonFootprintInput = () => { const [collapse, setCollapse] = useState({ transportation: false, energy: false, food: false, waste: false, sustainable: false, offset: false, additionalNotes: false, }); const [userData, setUserData] = useState({ carUsageKm: "", vehicleType: "", fuelType: "", publicTransportTrips: "", publicTransportMode: "", flightsPerYear: "", electricityUsage: "", heatingMethod: "", homeSize: "", energyEfficientAppliances: false, dietType: "", meatFrequency: "", recyclingHabit: false, wasteGeneration: "", renewableEnergyUse: false, ecoFriendlyProducts: false, sustainableShopping: false, carbonOffsetProgram: "", carbonOffsetDetails: "", additionalNotes: "", }); const [formStatus, setFormStatus] = useState(null); // To manage confirmation message state const handleChange = (e) => { const { id, value, type, checked } = e.target; setUserData({ ...userData, [id]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value, }); }; const toggleCollapse = (section) => { setCollapse((prevState) => ({ ...prevState, [section]: !prevState[section], })); }; const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); // Log the data for debugging console.log("Form Data Submitted:", userData); // Check for missing required fields const missingFields = []; for (let field in userData) { if (userData[field] === "" || userData[field] === false) { missingFields.push(field); } } // If there are missing fields, return early and log them if (missingFields.length > 0) { console.log("Missing fields: ", missingFields); setFormStatus({ type: "error", message: "Please fill in all required fields!" }); return; } // Log successful form submission attempt console.log("No missing fields, proceeding with submission."); // Get the user's ID from Firebase Authentication (assuming user is logged in) const user = getAuth().currentUser; const userId = user ? user.uid : null; if (userId) { try { // Initialize Firebase database const db = getDatabase(); const userRef = ref(db, `users/${userId}/userfootprint`); await set(userRef, userData); console.log("Data successfully saved to Firebase"); // Confirmation message on successful submission setFormStatus({ type: "success", message: "Your carbon footprint data has been successfully submitted!", }); } catch (error) { console.error("Error saving data to Firebase:", error); setFormStatus({ type: "error", message: "There was an error saving your data. Please try again.", }); } } else { console.log("User is not logged in."); setFormStatus({ type: "error", message: "You must be logged in to submit your data.", }); } }; return ( <>
